parameters.name: production_by_period
parameters.description: number of fighter jets produced and available in each period

parameters.name: training_capacity_per_jet
parameters.description: number of pilots one training jet can train per period

parameters.name: training_start_period
parameters.description: first period in which training is allowed

parameters.name: availability_lag
parameters.description: number of periods after training before a pilot is available for combat

parameters.name: training_cost_by_period
parameters.description: optional cost of assigning one jet to training in each period

variables.name: training_jets_allocated
variables.description: number of fighter jets allocated exclusively to training in each period

variables.name: pilots_trained
variables.description: number of pilots trained in each period

variables.name: trained_pilot_availability
variables.description: cumulative number of trained pilots available by the end of each period

constraints.name: training_nonnegativity
constraints.description: Training jets allocated each period must be nonnegative

constraints.name: trained_pilots_nonnegativity
constraints.description: Pilots trained each period must be nonnegative

constraints.name: availability_nonnegativity
constraints.description: Cumulative trained pilot availability must be nonnegative

constraints.name: training_integer_domain
constraints.description: Training jet allocations are integer-valued counts

constraints.name: availability_integer_domain
constraints.description: Cumulative trained pilot availability is integer-valued

constraints.name: training_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Training allocation in any period cannot exceed the fighter jets available in that period

constraints.name: pilot_training_capacity
constraints.description: The number of pilots trained in a period is limited by the capacity generated by training jets used in that period

constraints.name: training_start_restriction
constraints.description: Training is allowed only from the first allowable training period onward

constraints.name: combat_availability_lag
constraints.description: Pilots trained in period t become available only after the specified lag has passed; for each period, availability is the cumulative sum of training completions up to t-\delta, with the convention that empty sums are zero.

objectives.name: maximize_trained_pilots_available
objectives.description: Maximize the total number of trained pilots available by the end of the planning horizon, represented by the final cumulative availability value

final_objective.description: Maximize the cumulative number of trained pilots available by the end of the planning horizon; since the problem has a single explicit objective, use it directly as the final objective.
